title: SeatEvent
description: The payload of every supervisor-seat event (docs/plan/02-supervisor-role §5, docs/design/m0/08 "Supervisor seat"): <transition>/v1. There is one seat per controller: the event's subject is its id, a sea_ TypeID minted by its first event and the same for every seat event after. `from` is the holder before the transition and `to` the holder after it; on seat.handover_requested `from` is the holder asked and `to` the requester, and `force_after` is when the request wins (null: it only asks). internal/authority checks every transition against the current seat in the writer transaction.
